opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres (Centenary Research Centres)

amount.raw: Up to £10 million is available for up to 10 years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities registered by the Office for Students and holding their own research degree awarding powers; may be single university or collaboration between multiple institutions. Previously excluded institutions (Oxford, Cambridge, Imperial College London) eligible in this round.
opportunities.summary: Funding for UK universities to set up a Leverhulme Research Centre for outstanding original research aspiring to achieve a step-change in scholarship, encouraging new approaches that may establish or reshape a field of study.

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards (Centenary Research Leadership Awards)

amount.raw: Awards will be for up to £1 million, for staff salaries and associated costs

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career academics at an early stage of their career who have at least two years' experience after PhD, hold or are nominated for a permanent academic appointment at a UK university at lecturer level or equivalent, and have the right to work in the UK.
opportunities.summary: Enables talented early-career scholars to build a research team of sufficient scale to tackle a distinctive research problem, supporting career development, project management of a modest team and intellectual leadership.

opportunities.title: Research Project Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities, other institutions of higher education in the UK, and on a trial basis UK-based independent research institutes/organisations defined as eligible by UKRI.
opportunities.summary: Funding for researchers based at universities or institutions of higher education to undertake an innovative and original research project. The outline application stage is paused and will reopen in the new grants management system in autumn 2026.

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships

amount.raw: Applications are invited for a minimum value of £3,000 and a maximum of £24,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Senior researchers who have retired or partially retired (up to 0.5 FTE) from an academic post at a UK university or eligible institution, live in the UK for at least 26 weeks a year, and have an established record of research.
opportunities.summary: Support for senior researchers who have retired or partially retired from an academic post to complete a research project and prepare the results for publication.
discipline_tags: All subject areas except medical/clinical research

opportunities.title: Research Fellowships

amount.raw: The maximum value of a Fellowship is £70,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Experienced researchers holding a post in a UK university with research degree awarding powers extending beyond the duration of the Fellowship, resident in the UK at the time of application, and permanent members of the UK scholarly community.
opportunities.summary: Funding for experienced researchers in any discipline, particularly those prevented by routine duties from completing a programme of original research, to complete a piece of research over 3 to 24 months.
discipline_tags: All subject areas except medical/clinical research
